from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A judgment document with its title and case cause (案由)."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title or name of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The case cause (案由) as specified in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document, e.g. 二审行政判决书，民事二审裁定书，etc.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
